title: The Brother's Secret
summary: Dr. Vance reveals the horrifying truth: Tae-Jun possessed the Guardian Bloodline and willingly endured years of agony as Subject Zero to prevent Section 9 from hunting Ha-Jun.

panels.shot: vance on the wall monitor laughing with chilling arrogance
panels.action: Dr. Victor Vance swirls a glass of red wine on screen, his cybernetic optic zooming in on Ha-Jun's face.

dialogue.speaker: vance
dialogue.text: Rip this bunker in half? Ah, the raw temper of the Sovereign. Just like your father.

panels.prose_en: Dr. Victor Vance swirls a glass of red wine on screen, his cybernetic optic zooming in on Ha-Jun's face.
panels.prose_hi: Do. victor vens screen par red wine ka ek gilas ghumate han, unka cybernetic optic ha-jun ke chehre par zoom karta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun gripping the edge of the metal terminal crushing the steel
panels.action: Ha-Jun's bare fingers crush the three-inch solid steel edge of the terminal like wet cardboard.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's bare fingers crush the three-inch solid steel edge of the terminal like wet cardboard.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki nangi ungaliyan terminal ke teen inch ke thos steel kinare ko gile cardboard ki tarah kuchal deti han.

panels.shot: baek raising assault rifle toward the camera lens
panels.action: Baek aims at the ceiling camera: 'Vance, you violated the Geneva conventions and the Hunter Accords. Surrender the coordinates.'

dialogue.speaker: baek
dialogue.text: Your crimes are punishable by immediate execution, Vance.

panels.prose_en: Baek aims at the ceiling camera: 'Vance, you violated the Geneva conventions and the Hunter Accords. Surrender the coordinates.'.
panels.prose_hi: Bek ne sealing camere par nishana sadha: 'vence, aapne geneva sammelanon aur hunter samjhaute ka ullanghan kiya hai. nirdeshank samarpan karen.'

panels.shot: vance scoffing at baek on screen
panels.action: Vance sneers: 'Hunter Accords? Written by cowards afraid of human evolution. Look at what your beloved Tae-Jun achieved!'

dialogue.speaker: vance
dialogue.text: Tae-Jun was not my victim, Captain. He was my finest collaborator.

panels.prose_en: Vance sneers: 'Hunter Accords? Written by cowards afraid of human evolution. Look at what your beloved Tae-Jun achieved!'.
panels.prose_hi: Vence ne uphaas kiya: 'hunter samjhaute? manav vikas se darne wale kayaron dwara likhit. dekho aapke priy taaye-jun ne kya haasil kiya!'

panels.shot: ha-jun shouting in rage: 'collaborator?! he was your prisoner!'
panels.action: Ha-Jun's voice thunders with demonic resonance: 'He was fifteen years old! You tortured a child!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: TUMNE USSE TORTURE KIYA! WO BHAAG NAHI SAKTA THA!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's voice thunders with demonic resonance: 'He was fifteen years old! You tortured a child!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki awaaz rakshasi pratidhvani ke saath garjti hai: 'vah pandrah saal ka tha! tumne ek bacche par atyachar kiya!'

panels.shot: vance pressing a button playing video record 089
panels.action: Vance smirks: 'Is that what you believe? Watch record 089. See the contract he signed with his own blood.'
panels.prose_en: Vance smirks: 'Is that what you believe? Watch record 089. See the contract he signed with his own blood.'.
panels.prose_hi: Vence muskurate hue kahte han: 'kya aap yahi maante han? record 089 dekhen. us anubandh ko dekhen jis par unhone apne khoon se hastakshar kiye the.'

panels.shot: surveillance footage from 6 years ago: tae-jun in white holding cell
panels.action: Grainy black-and-white footage plays: 16-year-old Tae-Jun, covered in fresh bandages, sits across an interrogation table from Vance.
panels.prose_en: Grainy black-and-white footage plays: 16-year-old Tae-Jun, covered in fresh bandages, sits across an interrogation table from Vance.
panels.prose_hi: Danedar kale aur safed footage chalte han: 16 varshiya taaye-jun, taji pattiyon se dhaka hua, vens se puchtach ki mej ke samne baitha hai.

panels.shot: footage audio: tae-jun speaking clearly and coldly
panels.action: Tae-Jun speaks without fear: 'You want the Sovereign gene. I have it. But you will never touch Ha-Jun.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Mera blood sample lo, meri marrow lo, jo experiment karna hai karo. Par Ha-Jun ke aas-paas tumhara koi spy nahi dikhna chahiye.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun speaks without fear: 'You want the Sovereign gene. I have it. But you will never touch Ha-Jun.'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun bina kisi dar ke bolte han: 'aap sovereign jean chahte han. yah mere paas hai. lekin aap ha-jun ko kabhi nahin chhuyenge.'

panels.shot: footage: young vance nodding with a predatory grin
panels.action: Young Vance nods: 'A fair exchange, Subject Zero. One brother's agony for the other's peaceful childhood.'
panels.prose_en: Young Vance nods: 'A fair exchange, Subject Zero. One brother's agony for the other's peaceful childhood.'.
panels.prose_hi: Yang vens ne sir hilaya: 'ek uchit aadaan-pradan, vishay shunya. ek bhai ki peeda dusre ke shantipurna bachpan ke liye.'

panels.shot: ha-jun collapsing against terminal console shaking his head
panels.action: Ha-Jun stares at the screen in horror; tears drop freely onto his boots as the magnitude of Tae-Jun's sacrifice sinks in.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Mera harmless school life... Meri normal zindagi... Wo sab iske khoon se khareedi gayi thi!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stares at the screen in horror; tears drop freely onto his boots as the magnitude of Tae-Jun's sacrifice sinks in.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun bhaybhit hokar screen ki or dekhta hai; jaise hi taaye-jun ke balidan ki bhayavahata samne aati hai, aansu uske jooton par aasani se tapakne lagte han.

panels.shot: vance explaining the chimera cores created from tae-jun blood
panels.action: Vance points to a 3D hologram of a synthetic purple core: 'Every synthetic demon core we engineered used Tae-Jun's marrow as a stabilizing catalyst.'

dialogue.speaker: vance
dialogue.text: Without his Royal Guardian antibodies, synthetic demon cores would detonate their human hosts within seconds.

panels.prose_en: Vance points to a 3D hologram of a synthetic purple core: 'Every synthetic demon core we engineered used Tae-Jun's marrow as a stabilizing catalyst.'.
panels.prose_hi: Vence ek synthetic baingani core ke 3d hologram ki or ishara karte han: 'pratyek synthetic danav core jise humne engineer kiya tha, ek sthir utprerak ke roop mein taaye-jun ki majja ka upyog karta tha.'

panels.shot: min-jae clenching fists in disgusted fury
panels.action: Min-Jae: 'You treated an innocent boy like a living blood battery for your illegal army!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: You are a monster, Vance! A sick, twisted monster!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae: 'You treated an innocent boy like a living blood battery for your illegal army!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je: 'aapne apni avaidh sena ke liye ek nirdosh ladke ke saath jeevit khoon ki battery jaisa vyavahar kiya!'

panels.shot: vance smiling warmly at ha-jun on screen
panels.action: Vance leans closer into the camera: 'And where is Tae-Jun now, you ask? He is beyond mortal pain. He has been promoted.'

dialogue.speaker: vance
dialogue.text: He is in the Citadels of Tartarus. The Void Primordial needed a catalyst of Royal Blood to breach the Prime Gate.

panels.prose_en: Vance leans closer into the camera: 'And where is Tae-Jun now, you ask? He is beyond mortal pain. He has been promoted.'.
panels.prose_hi: Vence camere ke kareeb jhuk jata hai: 'aur ab taaye-jun kahan hai, aap puchte han? wah nashwar peeda se pare hai. unka promotion ho gaya hai.'

panels.shot: ha-jun looking up with terrifying stillness
panels.action: Ha-Jun's weeping stops instantly; his expression goes completely blank and cold like black volcanic glass.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's weeping stops instantly; his expression goes completely blank and cold like black volcanic glass.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ka rona turant band ho jata hai; uski abhivyakti kale jwalamukhiya kaanch ki tarah puri tarah se khali aur thandi ho jaati hai.

panels.shot: a profound quiet falling over the entire room
panels.action: The ambient electronic hum of the facility drops an octave; the air temperature plummets thirty degrees.
panels.prose_en: The ambient electronic hum of the facility drops an octave; the air temperature plummets thirty degrees.
panels.prose_hi: Suvidha ka pariveshiy electronic gunjan ek saptak girata hai; hawa ka taapmaan tees degree tak gir jata hai.

panels.shot: purple frost spreading across the water on the floor
panels.action: The ankle-deep water freezes instantly into crystalline purple ice, cracking under sheer demonic pressure.
panels.prose_en: The ankle-deep water freezes instantly into crystalline purple ice, cracking under sheer demonic pressure.
panels.prose_hi: Takhne tak gehra pani turant jam jata hai aur crystaliy baingani barf mein badal jata hai, jo rakshasi dabav ke karan toot jata hai.

panels.shot: kuro puffing black feathers his voice dropping low
panels.action: Kuro murmurs: 'The Sovereign's Wrath has awakened. Even I dare not speak.'
panels.prose_en: Kuro murmurs: 'The Sovereign's Wrath has awakened. Even I dare not speak.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro badbadata hai: 'samprabhu ka krodh jaag gaya hai. yahan tak ​​ki main bolne ki himmat bhi nahin kar pata.'

panels.shot: vance on screen looking slightly perturbed by sensor readings
panels.action: Vance glances off-screen at warning readouts: 'Energy spike of class SSS? How can a boy generate that without a core?!'

dialogue.speaker: vance
dialogue.text: Wait... Your mana density... What are those readings?!

panels.prose_en: Vance glances off-screen at warning readouts: 'Energy spike of class SSS? How can a boy generate that without a core?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Vence off-scrin chetavani par nazar dalte han: 'clas sss ki urja vridhi? bina core ke koi ladka ise kaise utpann kar sakta hai?!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun raising his right hand toward the ceiling
panels.action: Ha-Jun raises his right hand into the air, fingers splayed; dark violet gravitational lightning sparks between his fingertips.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun raises his right hand into the air, fingers splayed; dark violet gravitational lightning sparks between his fingertips.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apna dahina haath hawa mein uthata hai, ungaliyan alag ho jaati han; uski ungaliyon ke beech gahre baingani rang ki gurutvakarshan bijli chamakti hai.

panels.shot: all ten relics manifesting around ha-jun in full visual glory
panels.action: Feather, Ring, Bone, Heart, Fang, Eye, Chains, Crown, Devourer, Hourglass ignite around his body in a ring of planetary fire.
panels.prose_en: Feather, Ring, Bone, Heart, Fang, Eye, Chains, Crown, Devourer, Hourglass ignite around his body in a ring of planetary fire.
panels.prose_hi: Pankh, anguthi, haddi, hridy, daant, aankh, janjeer, mukut, bhakshak, ghantaghar uske shareer ke charon or grahon ki aag ki anguthi mein prajvalit hote han.

panels.shot: ha-jun speaking in the ancient sovereign tongue
panels.action: Two voices overlap from Ha-Jun's lips—his own young voice and the ancient titan Asmodaius: 'Vance.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Vance. Tumne socha tha tum shaitan ko control kar rahe the.

panels.prose_en: Two voices overlap from Ha-Jun's lips—his own young voice and the ancient titan Asmodaius: 'Vance.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ke hothon se do aawazen nikalti hain - uski apni yuva awaaz aur prachin titan esmodius: 'vence.'

panels.shot: ha-jun closing his fist in a crushing motion
panels.action: Ha-Jun clenches his fist with decisive finality: 'You were only building your own tomb.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tumne sirf apni qabar khodi hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun clenches his fist with decisive finality: 'You were only building your own tomb.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne nirnayak ant ke saath apni mutthi band kar li: 'aap keval apni kabr bana rahe the.'

panels.shot: the reinforced concrete ceiling above beginning to groan and cave
panels.action: A thousand tons of steel rebar and granite bedrock groan under an invisible gravitational press.
panels.prose_en: A thousand tons of steel rebar and granite bedrock groan under an invisible gravitational press.
panels.prose_hi: Ek adrishya gurutvakarshan dabav ke neeche hajaron ton steel sariya aur granite aadharshila karah rahi hai.

panels.shot: vance shouting into his mic: 'release subject chimera prime!'
panels.action: Vance slams his fist on his desk: 'Release Chimera Prime! Tear them to pieces before the ceiling collapses!'

dialogue.speaker: vance
dialogue.text: CHIMERA PRIME RELEASE SEQUENCE DELTA! KILL THEM ALL!

panels.prose_en: Vance slams his fist on his desk: 'Release Chimera Prime! Tear them to pieces before the ceiling collapses!'.
panels.prose_hi: Vence ne apni mutthi apni mej par mari: 'chimera prime ko release karo! chhat girne se pehle unhen tukde-tukde kar do!'.

panels.shot: hydraulic floor pod rising from center of theater
panels.action: A twenty-meter hydraulic elevator cylinder rises from the center floor, venting toxic yellow neuro-toxin gas.
panels.prose_en: A twenty-meter hydraulic elevator cylinder rises from the center floor, venting toxic yellow neuro-toxin gas.
panels.prose_hi: Ek bees meter ka hydraulic elevator cylinder madhya tal se uthta hai, jo jahrili pili neuro-toxin gas ko bahar nikalta hai.

panels.shot: massive 15-foot cyber-demon beast stepping out of mist
panels.action: A nightmarish fifteen-foot hulking monstrosity emerges—four arms with chainsaw blades, cybernetic spine, and six glowing red oculars.
panels.prose_en: A nightmarish fifteen-foot hulking monstrosity emerges—four arms with chainsaw blades, cybernetic spine, and six glowing red oculars.
panels.prose_hi: Ek bhayavah pandrah foot ki vishal rakshasi ubharti hai - chainsaw blade wali char bhujaen, cybernetic reedh aur chhah chamakti lal aankhen.

panels.shot: chimera prime roaring with deafening sonic shockwave
panels.action: The beast roars with 160 decibels of sonic fury, blowing away the fog and cracking the glass server screens.
panels.prose_en: The beast roars with 160 decibels of sonic fury, blowing away the fog and cracking the glass server screens.
panels.prose_hi: Janvar 160 decibel dhwani ke rosh ke saath dahadta hai, kohre ko uda deta hai aur glass server screen ko tod deta hai.

panels.shot: baek and min-jae raising weapons covering ears
panels.action: Min-Jae and Baek stumble back, ears ringing from the sonic boom: 'What the hell did Vance build?!'
panels.prose_en: Min-Jae and Baek stumble back, ears ringing from the sonic boom: 'What the hell did Vance build?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-jaye aur bak ladkhadakar wapas aa gaye, unke kanon mein dhwani ki gadgdahat gunj rahi thi: 'aakhir vens ne kya banaya?!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping calmly onto the frozen ice without flinching
panels.action: Ha-Jun walks toward the roaring titan with zero fear, the Sanguine Fang igniting with pitch-black hellfire in his grip.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tae-Jun hyung ke dard ka pehla installment... Yeh kachra chukayega.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun walks toward the roaring titan with zero fear, the Sanguine Fang igniting with pitch-black hellfire in his grip.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun bina kisi bhay ke dahadte hue titan ki or chalta hai, senguin fang uski pakad mein kali narkankaal ki aag se prajvalit ho raha hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun locking eyes with chimera prime cliffhanger
panels.action: Ha-Jun raises the black blood katana, purple eclipse rings spinning in his irises: 'Die.'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun raises the black blood katana, purple eclipse rings spinning in his irises: 'Die.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun kale rakt katana ko uthata hai, uski aankhon ki putliyon mein baingani grahan ke chhalle ghumte han: 'mar jao.'
